title: NASA Sun fact sheet: escape velocity 617.6
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists escape velocity as 617.6.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists Escape velocity (km/s) as 617.6 for the Sun. A bulk-parameter cell. The sheet does not label this cell as a model. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
